purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations (temperature, dew point, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in 2013, intended to support downstream analyses such as joining to flight delay data by origin and hour.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour (the declared grain) to associate weather with other hourly events; wind_gust and pressure are frequently null (74.6% and 11.5% respectively) and wind_dir is null in 1.7% of rows, so consumers must handle nulls explicitly rather than assume full coverage, and must not treat retained nulls as zero or missing-data errors.
limitations: wind_gust is sparsely populated (null_rate 0.745505) and pressure and wind_dir also carry nontrivial null rates (0.114953 and 0.016828); these were retained nullable rather than imputed or dropped. No exact duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied beyond the grain declaration.
